description: Modified overlay to support Native path ring writer per NATIVE_DSACP_TASK.md

hooks.py: 1. capture_native_kv: serving mode now calls runtime.capture_native(latent, rope) instead of just returning (previously skipped Native in serving)
2. Serving initialization: removed RuntimeError that rejected Native exec_kv fallback (replaced with pass to allow Native path)
contract.py: 3. validate_runtime_contract: accepts both PROLOG_V3 and NATIVE (previously only PROLOG_V3)
serving_runtime.py: 4. require_layer_contract: accepts both PROLOG_V3 and NATIVE (previously only PROLOG_V3)
5. Added capture_native(latent, rope) method to ServingRuntime: reshapes [T,1,1,512]->[T,512], calls ring_writer.write_latent and write_rope for each token

data_flow.tap_location: patch_sfa_v1_mxfp4.py: k_nope [T,1,1,512] BF16 and k_rope [T,1,1,64] BF16 are captured by capture_native_kv(impl, k_nope, k_rope) before npu_dynamic_mx_quant
data_flow.native_writer: capture_native_kv -> runtime.capture_native(latent, rope) -> ring_writer.write_latent/write_rope per token
data_flow.original_path_unchanged: npu_dynamic_mx_quant and all original computation continues unchanged

implementation_notes: ServingRuntime.capture_native uses per-token loop with ring_writer (may need optimization for production)
TP-local shards: each TP rank writes its own tokens' ring data (BF16 exchange across ranks not yet implemented)
The ring_writer used in capture_native is a placeholder - actual ring writer kernel integration needs review
DSACP BF16 shard exchange (task item 4) not yet implemented - currently each rank writes local tokens only
remaining_work: 1. Verify capture_native is actually called (test with service startup)
2. Implement DSACP BF16 shard exchange for multi-TP correctness
3. Reader adaptation for CP local query routing
